issue.title: capture-related debug perf gate (500 ms wall clock) fails under parallel cargo test load
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-bc.3 note #2 and bob-cli-bc.4 note #4, and seen again by bob-cli-bc.7 note #1 and bob-cli-bc.13 note #1; triaged by the bob-cli-bc land agent.

`tests/cli/capture/related.rs::draft_related_stays_under_the_debug_perf_gate` asserts a wall-clock bound (`elapsed < 500ms`) on one debug-build `bob capture-related` run over a 40-note x 38-task fixture. It fails only when the full `cargo test` runs in parallel and passes in isolation on the same binary.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Observations (all on unchanged trees):
- bc.3: 667 ms isolated after compile, 775 ms in `cargo test --test cli`; prefs tree passes 3/3 at 330-400 ms after cooldown.
- bc.4: 1.2209 s in the broad capture run; passed in 0.35 s isolated on the same binary.
- bob-cli-bc land agent, master 7e41788c, 2026-10-24: `just check` failed with `draft query took 1.099197382s`; the targeted rerun `cargo test --test cli -- completion:: help_options::` did not include it, and the earlier phases' isolated reruns passed.
Fail rate: roughly every full `just check` run on apollo today (4+ of 4 broad runs); 0 isolated failures. capture-related does not load the Pomodoro theme catalog, so it is not caused by the themes epic. The likely remediation is a load-tolerant gate (a relative bound, a serial/ignored perf test, or a budget scaled for debug plus parallel load).

issue.creation_reason: Four bob-cli-bc phases and the land agent saw this wall-clock gate fail in full just check runs and pass in isolation; it is unrelated to the themes epic and keeps the canonical gate red.

payload.entry: Fixed by batch 9 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.4 in bob-cli 0e75ca56, a test-only change. One untimed warmup, then 7 paired timed runs against a trivial one-task baseline vault. The gate is min(big-tiny) < 500 ms plus a gross min(big) < 2000 ms. The phase showed that a deliberate +2 ms/candidate slowdown fails the gate, then reverted it. The lander reran cargo test --test cli -- --test-threads=64 three times at load average 7-22: 2053/2053 passed each time, including the gate. bob-cli CI 40196386071 on 6292c35b passed.
